text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Repatriated capital heats trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange.
- Kuwaiti-Saudi sea border to be demarcated soon, says Kuwaiti foreign minister.
- Group of banks and Gulf, international firms to finance Equate U.S.-Kuwaiti petrochemical project with $1.2 billion.
- Pentagon says no Iraqi troops near Kuwaiti border.
- Kuwait Investment Authority to sell 300 million shares of the state's stake in Securities Group.
- Tehran attacks Gulf Arab foreign ministers' statement on a dispute between Iran and the United Arab Emirates over three Gulf islands.
